title: SugarCraft — SugarServeProtocol
description: SugarServeProtocol: the wire contract for the candy-code.v1 serve protocol — WebSocket subprotocol names, frame cap, discovery-record and token readers, and address-to-WebSocket URL normalisation. Original work; first-party.
ogDescription: The candy-code.v1 serve protocol's wire constants and read-side helpers in one small package, so every client reads the same discovery record, token file and WebSocket URL.
tagline: candy-code.v1 wire contract — constants, discovery and token readers, URL rule
